title: Vietnam Flood Forecasting: code for an event-split benchmark of short-range flood inundation forecasting
description: Code for the paper "Do Geospatial Foundation Models Help Short-Range Flood Inundation Forecasting? An Event-Split Benchmark for Vietnam with Independent Label Checks". It builds a benchmark for one- to three-day flood inundation forecasting at 20 m in six river basins of northern and central Vietnam from Sentinel-1, Copernicus GFM labels, static layers and observed and forecast rainfall, trains a TerraMind fusion model and five baselines, and writes every table of the paper from the evaluation results.
